description: This file declares utility string functions such as split, trim, editDistance, StartsWith, EndsWith, and an internal helper for edit distance calculation, within the caffe2 namespace.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a separator character, optionally ignoring empty substrings.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: editDistance
methods.description: Calculates the Levenshtein edit distance between two strings, with an optional maximum distance cutoff.

methods.name: TORCH_API bool StartsWith(const std::string & str,const std::string & prefix)
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a specified prefix.

methods.name: TORCH_API bool EndsWith(const std::string & full,const std::string & ending)
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: editDistanceHelper
methods.description: Internal function to assist in computing edit distance, working with raw character pointers and length information.
